problem_statement: Small kirana stores lose 20% of revenue from stockouts and overstock
solution: AI demand forecasting and smart reorder alerts via WhatsApp
target_users: Small kirana store owners and managers in India
competitive_advantage: AI-powered demand forecasting and WhatsApp integration for ease of use
why_now: Growing smartphone penetration and increasing competition in the retail sector make AI-powered inventory management a necessity for small kirana stores
mvp_features: WhatsApp integration for smart reorder alerts
go_to_market_strategy: Partner with local wholesalers and distributors to offer the service to their kirana store customers
